activity_statements.statement: franchises and manages 9,900+ hotel properties across 30+ brands in 146 countries and territories under an asset-light model
operates the Marriott Bonvoy loyalty program connecting 200+ million members to hotel bookings, experiences, and rewards across its global portfolio
manages luxury hotel brands (Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, W Hotels, Bulgari) delivering premium hospitality for high-end leisure and business travelers
provides select-service hotel operations (Courtyard, Fairfield, Moxy) for value-conscious and business travelers at scale
manages extended-stay properties (Residence Inn, Element, TownePlace Suites) for long-duration guests including corporate relocations

name_reality_gap: none — Marriott International clearly signals a global hotel company. Notably, Marriott is primarily a fee-based management and franchising business, not a hotel owner — a distinction invisible to most outsiders.
extraction_notes: About page loaded and provided concrete data (9,900+ properties, 146 countries, 30+ brands). Asset-light model evident from page content. Bonvoy membership scale (200M+) is well-documented public fact.
